data.title: Elon Musk, Tom Lee, Shopify CEO Sign ‘Stand With Jensen’ Petition To Reinstate Him As Nvidia CEO
data.description:
Key points:
  • The signatories said that Huang should be reinstated while an independent investigation into the allegations surrounding him establishes the facts.
  • In the open letter, the group praised Huang for spending 33 years building Nvidia, arguing that his leadership and contributions to the company deserve fairness and due process rather than an abrupt removal.
  • The tracker lists nearly 2,700 existing Nvidia employees among those who have signed it, while over 20,000 existing Nvidia shareholders are said to have been among those who have pledged support for Huang.

Tesla Inc. (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk, Fundstrat’s Tom Lee, Shopify CEO Tobi Lutke and others have joined to sign a petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia Corp. (NVDA).

Nvidia shares fell more than 2% in Friday’s regular trading, declining over 1% more during the afterhours session.

What The ‘Stand With Jensen’ Petition Is About

The petition, “Stand with Jensen,” had about 36,000 signatures at the time of writing. The tracker lists nearly 2,700 existing Nvidia employees among those who have signed it, while over 20,000 existing Nvidia shareholders are said to have been among those who have pledged support for Huang to be reinstated as the company’s chief.

“A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too,” said Musk in a post on X.

The signatories said that Huang should be reinstated while an independent investigation into the allegations surrounding him establishes the facts.

In the open letter, the group praised Huang for spending 33 years building Nvidia, arguing that his leadership and contributions to the company deserve fairness and due process rather than an abrupt removal.

They also expressed concern that Huang was removed without meaningful due process, noting that they had not been presented with evidence substantiating allegations that the woman at the center of the controversy was a spy.

They urged the board to ensure an independent investigation, give Huang a fair opportunity to respond, disclose the inquiry's scope and timeline, and publicly explain the evidence and reasoning behind its decisions.

The letter emphasized that Huang should remain accountable, but argued that accountability must be based on evidence and a fair hearing.

Why Huang Stepped Down

Huang announced his decision to step down as Nvidia CEO, President, and a member of the board effective immediately on Thursday.

CFO Colette Kress has been appointed as the interim CEO while the company continues to search for a successor to Huang.

This came after reports revealed details about Huang’s extramarital affairs, including those with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset and an executive reporting directly to him.

What Retail Investors Think Of NVDA Stock

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits around Nvidia trended in the ‘extremely bullish’ territory at the time of writing.

NVDA stock is down 13% year-to-date. The S&P 500 ETF (SPY) and the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) are up 12% over the past 12 months.

data.title: HUDCO, PFC, Others Raise Over 10k cr Via Bond Sales
data.description:
Rozebud Gonsalves Mumbai: The corporate bond market saw three large issuances on Friday, raising a combined 8,441 crore, as issuers stepped up borrowings amid softer yields. State-owned HUDCO raised 2,500 crore through 10-year bonds, while PFC accepted 2,968 crore for 18-month bonds and 2,973 crore for five-year papers. Along with these three, Tata Capital Housing Finance, Nirmal Bang Securities and others issued smaller papers. "The HUDCO paper was likely presold, there were only three large bids which included LIC and EPFO, as this was a longer tenured paper.

It is because of this that their rate was below 8%," said a corporate bond dealer at a private firm. HUDCO was able to get a rate of 7.92% for their 10 year paper, while the Power Finance Corporation paper for 18 months and 5 years had rates of 8.21% and 8.05% respectively. The 10-year benchmark government bond yield rose 4 bps from its previous close to settle at 7.29% on Friday.

While the yield has edged up from around 7.15% levels seen last week, it remains below the 7.50% high recorded in October, according to CCIL data. A relatively softer benchmark yield and expectations of a rate hike in December has prompted a rush of corporate bond issuances of the past few weeks. Tata Capital Housing Finance raised 753 crore, while Nirmal Bang Securities raised 50 crore. These two issuances, along with a few other smaller bonds takes the single day aggregate to over 10,000 crore.

data.title: Sebi Clears Razorpay, MMT, Sembcorp IPOs Mumbai: Razorpay Software, MakeMyTrip India and
data.description:
Sebi Clears Razorpay, MMT, Sembcorp IPOs Mumbai: Razorpay Software, MakeMyTrip India and Sembcorp Green Infra have received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) to proceed with their initial public offerings (IPOs), according to updates on the regulator's website. Details of the proposed IPOs for Razorpay and MakeMyTrip were not available as both companies had filed their draft offer documents through the confidential pre-filing route.

Temasek Holdings-backed Sembcorp Green Infra, a Gurugram-based renewable energy independent power producer, is looking to raise 3,750 crore through its IPO. The proposed issue comprises an entirely fresh issue of shares with no offer for sale (OFS) component. Crystal Crop Protection IPO to Open on Nov 18 Mumbai: Crystal Crop Protection has fixed the price band for its 455.49 crore initial public offering (IPO) at 259-272 per share.

The issue will open for subscription on November 18 and close on November 20. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of 1.31 crore shares aggregating to 354.77 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 37.03 lakh shares worth 100.71 crore. IIFL Capital Services, DAM Capital Advisors and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd are the book-running lead managers to the issue. YES Bank Challenges SC Ruling on AT1 Bonds Mumbai: YES Bank has filed a review petition before the Supreme Court seeking reconsideration of its October 15 judgment relating to the write-down of Additional Tier-1 bonds aggregating to 8,415 crore, the bank said in an exchange filing on Friday. The Supreme Court had earlier upheld the quashing of the write-down of YES Bank's AT1 bonds, requiring restoration of the principal amount of 8,415 crore. The lender had subsequently said its board was evaluating available legal and capital options following the judgment.

data.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO May Open Next Week, Issue Size Pegged at 10k cr
data.description:
Himadri Buch Mumbai: Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL) IPO, a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India that received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on November 4, is planning to launch their IPO next week. The IPO of the company is likely to open on November 19 and close on November 23. The issue size of the proposed IPO is expected to be around 10,000 crore, people familiar with the development told ET. "The IPO will launch on November 19, while the price band is likely to be announced on Monday (November 16)," said a person familiar with the matter.

Emails and messages sent to the bankers remained unanswered until the copy went to the press. Coal India plans to divest up to 10% of its stake in MCL through the IPO. The proposed issue will comprise an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 66.18 crore equity shares by the parent company, Coal India, according to MCL's draft red herring prospectus (DRHP). There will be no fresh issue component in the issue, which means the proceeds from the offering will accrue to Coal India. SBI Capital Markets, Axis Capital, BOB Capital Markets, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities and IIFL Capital Services are the book-running lead managers to the issue. The proposed listing is part of Coal India's broader plan to unlock value in its subsidiaries through public offerings. The company has been taking its subsidiaries to the stock market this year. Bharat Coking Coal (BCCL) was listed in January, followed by Central Mine Planning & Design Institute (CMPDI) in March.

data.title: Former Dabur Global CEO to Lead Dubai's Group SNS
data.description:
Ratna Bhushan New Delhi: Mohit Malhotra, who stepped down as chief executive of Dabur last week, is set to join Dubai-based Group SNS as its global group CEO from November 16, people directly aware of the development said. Malhotra, who spent over three decades at Dabur in various leadership roles across Europe, Egypt, the Middle East and India, could not be reached for comments. He confirmed his move to Dubai in a LinkedIn post on Friday. "As I step into my next chapter in Dubai, I carry the same butterflies I had on Day 1 in 1994.

Perhaps that's a good thing: there's always a new learning curve," he wrote. He did not mention details of his new role. "To young professionals: don't plan every step. Take the difficult assignment. Learn more from the setbacks than you worry about the blame," his post added. An email query to Group SNS remained unanswered till press time on Friday.

The two-decades-plus SNS is a $1 billion-turnover company with business interests across fast moving consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and real estate, and a team of more than 18,000 employees, according to its website. India's consumer goods sector has seen several C-suite changes and churn over the past 12 months as challenges such as inflation, inconsistent demand trends, resurgent competition from regional and digital-first players and a continued volatile geopolitical environment persist. While Godrej Consumer Products and Colgate-Palmolive India announced abrupt changes to their leadership in recent months, last year saw new CEOs at Hindustan Unilever, Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages, L'Oreal and Britannia.

data.title: Grasim Ind's Q2 Profit Triples, Revenue up 33%
data.description:
Our Bureau Mumbai: Grasim Industries' profit for the September quarter nearly tripled year-on-year to 2,306 crore, aided by revenues rising 33% year-on-year to an all-time high of 12,747 crore. The revenue growth was led by continued growth momentum across the company's core and growth businesses, the company said, as key businesses such as cellulosic fibres, chemicals and textiles remained resilient despite global volatility, while the paints and B2B e-commerce businesses saw strong consumer and brand traction.

Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) rose 158% year-on-year to 4,615 crore, supported by a dividend income of 3,968 crore from UltraTech Cement and a favourable product mix, partially offset by higher input prices. "We believe that for this quarter, standalone results reflect actual underlying performance of the company, as compared to consolidated results," the company said in a statement. "The dividend from UltraTech of 3,968 crore is cash received by the company, which is accounted for in standalone results, however, gets eliminated in consolidated results," it said.

In its cellulosic fibres business, the company's revenue grew 29% year-on- year to 5,344 crore aided by volume growth, a favourable product mix and stable domestic realisations. This helped offset the impact of geo-political issues and higher input and logistics costs, the company said. EBITDA from the business rose 49% year-on-year to 522 crore. In its chemicals business, the company's revenue rose 15% year-on-year to 2,759 crore, while EBITDA fell 11% to 326 crore, due to higher power costs in the caustic soda business and lower profitability in the specialty chemicals business. Its decorative paints business 'Birla Opus' saw a 35% yoy growth in revenue to 1,337 crore, while volume growth stood at 20%.

data.title: General Insurers' Premium Income Up 10.5% in Oct
data.description:
Shilpy Sinha Mumbai: General insurance companies reported a 10.5% year-on-year increase in gross direct premium income to 32,761 crore in October, led by strong growth in standalone health insurers and private general insurers, according to provisional data released by the General Insurance Council. General insurers recorded a 10.15% increase in premium income to 28,062 crore during the month, while standalone health insurers (SAHIs) reported a 21.29% growth to 4,549 crore.

Among general insurers, HDFC ERGO recorded a 34.87% increase in premium income to 1,662 crore in October. SBI General grew 31.98% to 1,550 crore, while Bajaj General Insurance reported a 12.14% increase to 2,142 crore. ICICI Lombard's premium income rose 9.69% to 2,826 crore. Tata AIG reported a 15% increase in premium income to 2,265 crore, while IFFCO-Tokio grew 18% to 974 crore. Go Digit General Insurance, however, reported a 3.23% decline in premium income to 967 crore.

Among public sector insurers, National Insurance recorded a 16.11% increase in premium income to 3,287 crore, while New India Assurance reported a 2.94% growth to 3,880 crore. United India Insurance grew 11.55% to 1,775 crore, while Oriental Insurance reported a 2.64% decline to 1,479 crore. The standalone health insurance segment continued to outperform the broader industry. Care Health Insurance recorded a 34.56% increase in premium income to 1,129 crore, while Niva Bupa grew 20.05% to 826 crore. Star Health's premium income rose 17.65% to 1,721 crore. For the April-October period of FY27, the general insurance industry recorded a 9.13% increase in premium income to 2.12 lakh crore. General insurers reported a 9.23% growth to 1.79 lakh crore, while standalone health insurers posted a 29.18% increase to 30,135 crore.

data.title: Crude Shock, Inflation Sting End D-Street's Winning Run
data.description:
Sensex slips 0.39%, Nifty down 0.61%, end the week with gains Our Bureau Mumbai: Indian benchmark indices snapped a three-session winning streak on Friday as rising crude oil prices and a sharper-than-expected increase in retail inflation weighed on investor sentiment. Inflationary concerns and the possibility of a rate increase at the next monetary policy review dented D-Street sentiment.

The BSE Sensex fell 318.56 points, or 0.39%, to close at 81,592.45, while the NSE Nifty50 declined 155.05 points, or 0.61%, to 25,144.30. Despite Friday's decline, the benchmarks ended the week with gains. The Sensex rose 0.7%, while the Nifty gained 0.45%. Brent crude futures climbed to around $95.5 a barrel from nearly $92, as escalating attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz threatened global oil supplies.

Investor concerns intensified after India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, crossing the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit for the first time in two years. "The market's risk environment has become more complicated towards the end of the week with October retail inflation rose to 6.09%, moving above the RBI's upper tolerance band, while food inflation accelerated to 8.94%, raising concerns about the interest-rate outlook and household consumption," said Gaurav Garg, head -research, Lemonn.

He also said sustained increase in crude prices could put pressure on India's current account, the rupee, corporate input costs and inflation, potentially offsetting some of the benefits of foreign fund inflows. "Looking ahead, our near-term view remains cautiously positive, but we expect markets to undergo consolidation with intermittent volatility rather than continue moving higher in a straight line," Garg said.

Sectorally, realty, auto and cement stocks witnessed the sharpest selling pressure. Banking, financial services and metal shares also weighed on the benchmarks. Broader markets also ended lower, though losses were relatively contained. Both Nifty Midcap 150 Index and Nifty Smallcap 250 Index 0.3% each. In the last one week, Nifty Midcap 150 index has gained 1.84%, while Nifty Small Cap 250 Index went up 3.19%. The India VIX, a measure of market volatility, fell nearly 5.06%, indicating a moderation in expectations of near-term market volatility. "A decisive breach below 24,850 could accelerate selling pressure and expose the index to a further decline towards the 24,600 mark in the near term," said Sudeep Shah, head - Technical and Derivatives Research at SBI Securities.

data.title: CM Adhikari Set to Headline ET's Bengal Summit
data.description:
Adhikari, Swapan Dasgupta and Tapas Roy to share blueprint for Bengal's industrial revival Our Bureau Kolkata: The Economic Times is set to host Bengal Ascends, a grand summit that showcases the potential that West Bengal offers for manufacturing and services as the government aims to restore the shine of what was once the beating heart of Indian industry. Bengal Ascends will bring together industrialists, investors, economists and policy makers under one roof on November 24 at the ITC Sonar in Kolkata to lay down the economic road map for a state that was, among other things, formerly home to the nation's biggest lender, State Bank of India.

Chief minister Suvendu Adhikari, minister of public enterprises and industrial reconstruction Tapas Roy and finance minister Swapan Dasgupta-key decision makers in the state government-will not only share their vision for the state but also seek inputs from industry leaders on how to tailor policies to their needs. Economist and member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister Sanjeev Sanyal and ITC Chairman Sanjiv Puri will share their perspectives and prescriptions in fireside chats.

Deliberations will include how to re-industrialise the state that used to be reputed for its jute and textile industries, and utilise the abundant tech talent pool in the era of GCCs and AI. The flagship summit arrives amid a newfound energy in the state's corporate environment and the rollout of an industrial policy aimed at reviving West Bengal's economic glory.

Through curated sessions, business chiefs will also provide actionable feedback on single-window clearance mechanisms, land availability and infrastructure priorities while mapping out greenfield and brownfield investments. Bengal Ascends will act as a catalyst, aligning India Inc.'s capital with the dawn of a new economic era in the state under new leadership.

data.title: Cruise Mode: Cars Sales Race to October Best
data.description:
2w & 3w sales also remain healthy amid strong demand Our Bureau New Delhi: Domestic car sales accelerated 12.4% year-on-year to a record high in October as manufacturers rushed stock to dealerships ahead of the Dhanteras and Diwali festivals. Demand for two-wheelers also remained buoyant, pointing to robust appetite among entry-level buyers during the festive period.

Figures released by the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM) show that 519,060 hatchbacks, sedans and utility vehicles were sold in October, compared with 461,614 units sold in the year-ago period. The previous sales record was set in October 2025, after the goods and services tax rate cuts. "Indian automobile industry continues to witness healthy demand momentum. The passenger vehicle segment achieved its strongest-ever October performance, crossing the significant milestone of 500,000 units in monthly sales," said Rajesh Menon, director general, SIAM. Major manufacturers-Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors PV, Mahindra & Mahindra, Hyundai Motor and Kia India-all posted their highest-ever monthly figures.

Partho Banerjee, senior executive officer (market and sales), Maruti Suzuki, said, "This is the highest-ever sales we have recorded in a month in the domestic market since inception. We have seen strong growth across categories, be it small cars or SUVs (sport utility vehicles)." Two-wheeler sales also increased sharply in October, up 16.1% year-on-year to 2,577,810 units.

Growth was largely fuelled by scooters, where volume surged 31.6% to 1,096,756 units. Motorcycle sales rose 6.6% to 1,423,118 units. "In the two-wheeler segment, demand continues to be supported by improved credit availability and replacement demand, across both rural and urban markets. For three-wheelers, last-mile mobility requirements and rapid electrification remain strong structural drivers. Overall, the demand outlook remains positive," Menon added. Three-wheeler sales increased 25.7% year-on-year to 103,349 units last month.

data.title: Warburg Pincus Picks up Stake in Pricol Unit for 1,663 crore
data.description: ET Bureau New Delhi: Warburg Pincus has bought a minority stake in a unit of Coimbatore-based auto components player Pricol for 1,663 crore, as per a late evening stock exchange disclosure on Friday. Topaz Terrace investments, an affiliate of Warburg Pincus, will acquire a significant minority stake in Pricol Autotech, an arm of the auto components maker that manufactures digital dashboards and instrument clusters for two wheeler makes such as TVS, Honda Motorcyle, Royal Enfield and Ather Energy. ET had first reported on Thursday that Warburg Pincus was leading the race to acquire a minority stake in a unit of Pricol. The deal will entail a stake purchase from existing shareholders of the Pricol unit, including Vijay Mohan, Vikram Mohan, Vanitha Mohan, Viren Mohan, Manasa Mohan, Madhura Mohan and certain other promoter entities.

data.title: Grasim Profit Triples on Record-High Revenues
data.description:
Our Bureau Mumbai: Grasim Industries' standalone net profit nearly tripled to 2,306 crore for the second quarter, when the Aditya Birla Group flagship company said it witnessed continued momentum across its core and growth businesses. Revenue rose 33% from a year earlier to an all-time quarterly high of 12,747 crore for the three months ended September 30. Key businesses such as cellulosic fibres, chemicals and textiles remained resilient in the quarter despite global volatility, while the paints and B2B ecommerce segments saw strong consumer and brand traction, the company said.

Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation rose 158% on year to 4,615 crore, led by a dividend income of 3,968 crore from UltraTech Cement and a favourable product mix, partially offset by higher input prices, it said. At a consolidated level, the company reported a loss of 234.08 crore. This compares to a profit of 594.52 crore in the year-ago period. Consolidated revenue rose 26% on year to 50,105 crore, while consolidated Ebitda was 25% higher at 6,513 crore.

The consolidated bottom line was impacted due to accounting for an exceptional charge of 767 crore towards impairment/estimated exposure in pulp JV, AV Group NB, Canada, the company said. "We believe that for this quarter, standalone results reflect actual underlying performance of the company, as compared to consolidated results," Sterlite said in a news release. "The dividend from UltraTech of 3,968 crore is cash received by the company, which is accounted in standalone results, however, gets eliminated in consolidated results," it said. In its cellulosic fibres business, the company's revenue grew 29% on year to 5,344 crore aided by volume growth, a favourable product mix and stable domestic realisation. This helped offset the impact of geopolitical issues and higher input and logistics costs, the company said. Ebitda from the business rose 49% to 522 crore.

data.title: Franklin Templeton Is Seeing a Turnaround. The Stock Is, Too. — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Doug Busch

Franklin Templeton is showing signs of a meaningful turnaround.

The global asset manager has been benefiting from improving operating performance, stronger client inflows, and continued expansion across alternative investments and private markets. For example, assets under management increased 8% to approximately $1.8 trillion in the fiscal year ended Sept. 30, 2026.

All of this suggests the company's business momentum is strengthening, providing a fundamental backdrop for the recent improvement in the stock's technical picture.

Among fellow large-cap asset managers, there has been some positive action, too. SEI Investments has carved out a cup base pattern and trades just 3% below its 52-week high following a strong bounce off the very round $100 number on October 1. BlackRock stock has broken above its own cup base trigger of $1187.27 on Nov. 4, jumping more than 4% — although it did record a bearish engulfing candle the very next session, one day after the midterm election euphoria.

Keep an eye on State Street stock as well: It is stalking its 50-day simple moving average just above here. If it reclaims that important line, the right side of its own cup base starts to take shape.

Let's take a closer look at Franklin Templeton's daily and weekly charts to understand what is driving our bullish outlook and determine whether the recent momentum has room to carry the stock higher.

Looking at the daily chart, the ratio chart against the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR Fund demonstrates sustained outperformance over the trailing year, punctuated by a recent breakout from a six-month consolidation phase.

Near-term trend integrity remains firm as price action holds comfortably above its rising 21-day exponential moving average. Earlier in the cycle, the stock broke above a prior cup-with-handle base by clearing its $28.38 pivot trigger on April 28 with a 7% single-session surge. The lows of the base were anchored by a March 31 bullish morning star and an April 6 doji.

Following a multi-month period of digestion, shares have decisively reaccelerated. On Nov. 9, the stock cleared a $35.20 double-bottom trigger with a move exceeding 6%, propelled by its fourth consecutive positive earnings reaction. That base originated with an Aug. 5 bearish engulfing candle and established a trough on Oct. 15, where a bullish engulfing reversal defended the rising 200-day simple moving average.

One can enter here and the stock could reach $41 by mid-2027, a 14% gain from current prices, along with a dividend yield close to 4%. Remain bullish above $34.

Turning to the weekly chart, notice that a good clue suggesting the right side of a long cup with handle base was about to accelerate higher was the bullish RSI divergence that occurred in September 2024 and April 2025. The stock's price made a lower low while the RSI made a higher low, indicating selling pressure was abating. That five-year pattern started with a bearish evening star which completed the week ending Jan. 21, 2022, with a 10% slump.

Meaningful lows during the base came with a long legged spinning top candle in October 2022, a bullish piercing line in April 2025, and a morning star this past April just before a bullish golden cross. The handle was created with a bearish shooting star the first week of August, closing 7% off its intraweek high. One could add above the $36.38 pivot, and on this time frame, the stock could reach $56 some time in mid-2028.

Doug Busch is the senior technical analyst at Barron's Investor Circle. His technical view is added to stock picks, including those published exclusively for Investor Circle readers. A glossary of technical terms is updated regularly with new entries.

data.title: YES Bank denies ₹32 crore cyber fraud report, says no government accounts affected
data.description:
YES Bank on Friday, November 13, denied a report alleging that it had suffered a cyber fraud loss of approximately ₹32 crore (around $3.4 million) involving government accounts, stating that its systems had not been compromised and no financial loss had been incurred.

The clarification follows a report published by The Banker, a Financial Times Group publication, on November 13, titled ‘India on high alert after alleged $3.4mn cyber loss at Yes Bank’. The report alleged that the bank had suffered the loss in a cyber fraud incident involving government accounts towards the end of October 2026.

In a statement, YES Bank said no government accounts had been affected, and there had been no financial loss linked to the alleged incident. It termed the claims in the report factually incorrect and said they did not reflect the actual position.

The bank said it had taken up the matter with the publication, pointed out the factual inaccuracies and sought a retraction. It added that the publication of incorrect information could harm the bank's reputation and create unwarranted concerns among stakeholders.

Yes Bank Q2 results

Last month, YES Bank reported a 65% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹1,080 crore for the September quarter, while net interest income (NII), or core income, rose 22.7% to ₹2,822.5 crore from ₹2,301 crore in the year-ago period.

Net interest margin (NIM) improved to 2.6% from 2.5% a year earlier, although it was lower than 2.7% in the June quarter. Other income increased to ₹1,881.5 crore from ₹1,644.3 crore, while provisions declined to ₹317.4 crore from ₹395 crore in the preceding quarter.

Asset quality remained stable, with gross non-performing assets (NPAs) at 1.2% and net NPAs at 0.2%. Gross slippages stood at ₹1,035 crore, compared with ₹1,248 crore in the year-ago quarter, while recoveries and upgrades amounted to ₹954 crore.

Managing Director and CEO Vinay M Tonse said the bank's performance was supported by growth in core operating income and an improvement in asset quality.

Shares of Yes Bank ended 1.5% lower on Friday at ₹17.42. The stock has declined about 19% so far in 2026 and nearly 23% over the last 12 months.

data.title: Tesla invites select customers to buy Cybercab for personal use
data.description:
Tesla said on Friday it was inviting select customers to buy the Cybercab for personal use, marking a push towards delivering fully designed autonomous vehicles to customers.

  • Tesla posted the announcement on X with an image of the golden, butterfly-door two-seater, priced at $29,990 with an “Autonomy Subscription” of $299 a month.

  • The EV maker aims to start selling its Cybercab robotaxis to the public by the end of this year, Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of vehicle engineering, said last month.

  • The Cybercab will work unsupervised in all the same geo locations as the robotaxi, Tesla’s head of artificial intelligence, Ashok Elluswamy, said in a separate X post.

  • Tesla launched its unsupervised robotaxi service in Austin, Texas, in June 2025, expanded the offering to Dallas and Houston in April 2026 and rolled it out in Miami in July 2026.

data.title: Nvidia fallout throws spotlight on Southeast Asia's AI boom
data.description:
Key points:
  • Chip firms and data centres expect greater scrutiny after Nvidia fallout
  • 'Like a DeepSeek moment', says CEO of Malaysia data centre consultancy
  • Singapore and US likely to tighten rules on chips, data centres - researcher
  • Malaysia weighs law to monitor data centre operations

By Xinghui Kok and Rozanna Latiff

Southeast Asia's chip and data centre industries expect greater scrutiny after news of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese spy put the spotlight on Singapore and Malaysia, executives and analysts said.

US lawmakers from both parties are pushing for tougher restrictions on China's access to advanced artificial intelligence chips after the Huang scandal increased scrutiny of Nvidia's role in US national security.

Washington restricts exports to China of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips to protect US dominance of the sector, but lawmakers want to close a loophole that allows Chinese firms to rent computing power from overseas data centres and access the systems equipped with the chips remotely.

Tougher regulations could include new export rules and licensing requirements to Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Singapore, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The alleged spy, Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, was an executive at a cloud computing firm in Singapore called Megaspeed that has subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Australia and the US.

Megaspeed has been under investigation by Singapore authorities since February last year for potential false declarations in relation to the purchase of servers and other related offences.

"After this case, every operator in the chain will be expected to know its end user. Southeast Asian operators will still get Nvidia chips, but proof of where every chip sits and who it serves is now part of the product," said Ke Yan, head of research at Singapore-based investment research firm Shenton Research.

'POST-DEEPSEEK MOMENT'

Southeast Asia's data centre industry is thriving. Since 2021, Malaysia has approved 385.7 billion ringgit ($94.67 billion) of data centre-related investments in the country, according to the trade ministry, while Thailand has 42 data centres, representing 3,400 MW of IT load and about 750 billion baht ($22.58 billion) in investment as of February.

Indonesia's data centre market was valued at $2.81 billion in 2025.

Gary Goh, CEO of Malaysia-based data centre consultancy Sprint DC, likened the current situation to a "post-DeepSeek moment". "Once the new rules are out, there will be a lot more restrictions for countries like Malaysia. There could be a short- to medium-term market shock to the Malaysian data centre market," said Goh.

The AI boom has boosted the region, with Singapore in August raising its economic growth forecast to 4.5%-5.5% this ​year, from 2.0%-4.0%, citing the AI cycle. In Malaysia, rising data centre development projects pushed the construction sector up 6% in the third quarter of 2026.

Singapore's and Malaysia's trade ministries did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Malaysia on Thursday said it was weighing a law that will allow the government to monitor data centre operations, including their use of high-performance chips, saying it needed to ensure that any chips subject to US restrictions were imported into Malaysia for domestic use, rather than for re-export.

An investor and CEO of an Asian neocloud company, who declined to be named, spent Friday morning in calls with lawyers in the US. "Everyone is still figuring out... Maybe every time you export something, there will be additional process to go through. We are worried about more scrutiny which will make it longer for chips to come through," the CEO said.

In February 2025, Singapore said that while 22% of Nvidia's chip sales were booked to entities with operations in Singapore only 1% physically came to Singapore. Singapore has also just charged a fifth person in an AI server fraud case.

Jarick Seet, head of small-mid caps at Maybank, said the region could weather tighter rules. "Singapore itself will be more stringent, I think it's a natural thing that happens. Singapore will tighten rules and the US will tighten rules, but I don't think this will harm Singapore's and Malaysia's prospect of buying chips."

A senior executive at a chip maker in Singapore, who declined to be named, even sees a silver lining. "With Jensen out, then the Chinese will have a harder time getting chips from the US. Maybe it is not a bad thing for the non-US people who will have more access to chips."

If the US slows building data centres following Democratic victories in key data-centre states such as Texas and Georgia in midterm elections, "those companies are going to look elsewhere and likely come to countries that can offer them land and deals and power," the executive said. "Even if we lose a chunk of the China business, I think we will get other companies coming looking for compute."

data.title: Drug regulator halts obeticholic acid production, orders recall
data.description:
New Delhi, Nov. 14 -- India's apex drug regulator has ordered an immediate halt to the manufacturing, sale, and distribution of obeticholic acid tablets and directed companies to recall the chronic liver disease medication pending a fresh safety review, according to two officials and a document seen by Mint.

The Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi has sought the cancellation of manufacturing licences for obeticholic acid (5mg and 10mg tablets), approved in India in March 2020 to treat primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), following recommendations from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation's (CDSCO) subject expert panel on gastroenterology and hepatology.

The regulator had referred the matter to its gastroenterology and hepatology experts to assess whether obeticholic acid should continue to be sold in India after global regulators, including the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) and the European Medicines Agency, recommended revocation of the drug's authorization due to risks of serious liver injury and a lack of confirmed clinical efficacy.

"Obeticholic acid 5mg/10mg tablets approved by the CDSCO on 11.03.2020 are being marketed in the country for primary biliary cholangitis. However, the European Medicines Agency, in its press release dated 28.06.2024, has recommended that obeticholic acid's marketing authorization be revoked, because its benefits are no longer considered to outweigh its risks," read the 10 November directive.

"The drug has also been withdrawn from the US market after the FDA request dated 12.09.2025. The reasons for withdrawal in the US and the European Union were failure to show efficacy and serious liver injury in some patients," the document said.

The directive also referred to the global assessment of Ocaliva, the drug's innovator brand. "As per the published global regulatory review, the clinical benefits of innovator products have not been confirmed. In particular, study 747-302 failed to show that Ocaliva (innovator) was more effective than placebo (a dummy treatment) in terms of the number of patients whose disease worsened or who died, both in the overall population and in a group of patients with early-stage PBC," the document said.

The regulator added that supplementary evidence did not alter the assessment of the trial outcome. "It was also considered that the data from supportive studies and real-world data were not sufficient to confirm the benefits of Ocaliva and could not counterbalance the negative results of study 747-302," the document added.

Pharmaceutical industry experts questioned the regulatory delay. "Once the USFDA and European Medicines Agency stopped the drug over serious safety risks and even halted clinical trials, what prevented the subject expert committee from acting for more than a year?," asked Uday Bhaskar, former director general at Pharmaceuticals Export Promotion Council of India (Pharmexcil).

"While around 10 to 11 manufacturers continued making the API (active pharmaceutical ingredient) and formulations here, stocks remained in the market for patients to consume. Moreover, how effective this recall will actually be across the country remains a big question mark," he added.

Generic versions of obeticholic acid are marketed in India by several companies, including Cipla Ltd, Zydus Lifesciences Ltd, Alkem Laboratories Ltd and Natco Pharma Ltd. Mint's queries sent to the Union health ministry, CDSCO, Cipla, Zydus, and Alkem on Thursday, and to Intercept Pharmaceuticals and Natco Pharma on Friday, remained unanswered.

Medical specialists advised that patients currently on the medication should seek medical evaluation rather than stop treatment without guidance. "The drug can cause severe itching, worsening liver function and, in some patients, serious liver injury, including liver failure. While stopping the medicine does not typically cause withdrawal symptoms, the underlying liver disease, PBC, continues to require treatment and monitoring," said Sharad Malhotra, senior consultant and director, Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Therapeutic Endoscopy, Aakash Healthcare.

He further added that the priority now must be to ensure that affected patients receive timely medical guidance, appropriate alternative therapies and regular follow-up, while strengthening regulatory vigilance to prevent such delays in future.

data.title: Novo Nordisk Secures EU Approval For FREHEMGO In Haemophilia A
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Novo Nordisk (NVO, NOVOB.CO, NOV.DE) has received European Commission marketing authorization for FREHEMGO (denecimig), a next-generation therapy for the routine prophylaxis of bleeding episodes in adults and children with haemophilia A, with or without inhibitors.

The approval marks a significant milestone for the company and expands treatment options for people living with haemophilia A, a rare inherited bleeding disorder caused by a deficiency of clotting factor VIII (FVIII). Patients with the condition face an increased risk of spontaneous and prolonged bleeding, which can lead to joint damage and other serious complications if not adequately controlled.

FREHEMGO is a factor VIIIa mimetic bispecific antibody administered as a subcutaneous injection. Designed to offer greater flexibility and convenience, the therapy can be given once weekly, once every two weeks, or once monthly using a single-use pre-filled pen. The dosing options allow patients and healthcare providers to tailor treatment schedules according to individual needs and preferences.

The European Commission's approval follows clinical data demonstrating the therapy's ability to effectively prevent or reduce bleeding episodes in patients with haemophilia A, regardless of inhibitor status. Inhibitors, which are antibodies that neutralize replacement clotting factors, remain one of the most challenging complications in haemophilia treatment.

Novo Nordisk said it plans to introduce FREHEMGO in the first European markets over the coming year, paving the way for broader patient access across the region.

Beyond Europe, the therapy has already secured approval in Saudi Arabia and remains under regulatory review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and other health authorities worldwide. Additional approvals could further strengthen Novo Nordisk's presence in the haemophilia market and expand access to the treatment globally.

NVO closed Friday's regular trading at $41.63 up $0.98 or 2.41%. But in the after-hours trading, the stock dropped $0.19 or 0.46%.

data.title: Zai Lab Announces First-Time Inclusion of KarXT and VYVGART Hytrulo® in China’s 2026 National Reimbursement Drug List, Expanding Access to Key Growth Products
data.description:
Zai Lab Limited (; ), an innovation-driven, global biopharma company, today announced that five of its commercial medicines in China have been included in the country’s 2026 National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL). The update includes two first-time listings, expanding patient access to treatments for gMG and schizophrenia, and three renewals, which maintain access across oncology and infectious disease.

Zai Lab Products Newly Added or Renewed in 2026 NRDL:

First-time listings:

  • VYVGART Hytrulo® (efgartigimod alfa, subcutaneous injection): for the treatment of adult patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG).

  • KarXT (xanomeline and tropsium chloride capsules): for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults.

Renewals:

  • NUZYRA® (omadacycline for injection): for the treatment of community-acquired bacterial pneumonia and acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections.

  • QINLOCK® (ripretinib tablets): for the treatment of adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) who have received prior treatment with three or more kinase inhibitors, including imatinib.

  • AUGTYRO® (repotrectinib capsules): for the treatment of adult patients with ROS1-positive locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and adult patients with solid tumors harboring a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion.

“The inclusion of KarXT and VYVGART Hytrulo in the NRDL represents an important milestone for Zai Lab and the patients we serve,” said Dr. Yizhe Wang, Zai Lab Operating Partner. “These listings will help broaden access to two important therapies, including KarXT’s novel mechanism of action for schizophrenia and the convenience of VYVGART Hytrulo’s subcutaneous administration for patients with gMG. Together with the renewal of our other listed products, we are grateful to the National Healthcare Security Administration for its continued support of innovative medicines and remain committed to delivering greater benefit to patients.”

The 2026 National Reimbursement Drug List will take effect on January 1, 2027.

  • Notice:



  • *xanomeline and trospium chloride capsules included in the 2026 NRDL covers the following specifications: (I) xanomeline tartrate 50 mg (calculated as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 20 mg per capsule; (II) xanomeline tartrate 100 mg (as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 20 mg per capsule; (III) xanomeline tartrate 125 mg (as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 30 mg per capsule. All are indicated for schizophrenia in adults.



  • *For AUGTYRO® included in the 2026 NRDL, the reimbursement scope for adult patients with NTRK gene fusion-positive solid tumors is specifically: adult patients diagnosed, by a well-validated testing method, with solid tumors harboring a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, and who meet one of the following conditions: having locally advanced or metastatic disease, or for whom surgical resection is likely to result in severe complications, or who have failed prior treatment or have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.

data.title: Innovative Immunology Biotech Windward Bio Lists on Nasdaq
data.description:
SHANGHAI, Nov. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Windward Bio, a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and a clinical-stage biotechnology company, successfully listed on Nasdaq on November 13, 2026. Windward Bio (Nasdaq: WWB) priced its IPO at $17.00 per share. Its shares closed at $28.50 on the first trading day, up 68% from the IPO price, giving the company a market capitalization of approximately $1.69 billion. This is Qiming Venture Partners' 11th IPO in 2026.

Qiming Venture Partners invested in Windward Bio's inaugural Series A financing in 2025 and continued to support the company in its Series B financing in 2026. Qiming also participated in this IPO financing round.

Windward Bio was founded in 2024 with a mission to transform the treatment paradigm for patients living with chronic inflammatory diseases through the development of differentiated biologic therapies targeting clinically validated disease pathways. Led by a team with extensive expertise across discovery, development, and commercialization, Windward Bio is advancing a pipeline of ultra-long-acting antibody medicines to improve clinical outcomes, reduce treatment burden and expand treatment options for patients with serious respiratory and dermatologic diseases, including asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and atopic dermatitis.

Windward Bio's lead program, WIN378, is a potentially novel anti-TSLP monoclonal antibody engineered for improved potency and extended half-life. WIN378 is currently being evaluated in POLARIS-1, a Phase 2/3 study in severe uncontrolled asthma, and SIRIUS, a Phase 2 study in COPD. The company's pipeline also includes WIN027, a clinical-stage, long-acting bispecific antibody targeting TSLP and IL-13 with potential applications across multiple inflammatory and immunological diseases. Windward Bio holds exclusive global rights (excluding Greater China and certain Asian countries) to WIN378 through a licensing agreement with Kelun-Biotech and Harbour BioMed, and has separately licensed WIN027 from Qyuns Therapeutics.

"Qiming Venture Partners invests in differentiated, globally competitive biotech innovation designed to address significant unmet needs for patients, and Windward Bio exemplifies this approach. We believe novel, long-acting biologics will reshape the treatment of severe chronic respiratory and skin diseases, and that WIN378 and WIN027 have the potential to expand and meaningfully improve the treatment options available to patients. In the hands of Luca and his team, with their expertise and proven track record, Windward is well-positioned to deliver on this potential, and we look forward to supporting the company through its next phase of growth," said Alexander Sinclair Wilson, Principal at Qiming Venture Partners.

About Qiming Venture Partners

Qiming Venture Partners was founded in 2006. Currently, Qiming Venture Partners manages eleven US Dollar funds and seven RMB funds with $9.5 billion in capital raised. Since our establishment, we have invested in outstanding companies in the Technology and Healthcare industries at the early and growth stages.

Since our debut, we have backed over 630 fast-growing and innovative companies. Over 290 of our portfolio companies have achieved exits through IPOs at the NYSE, NASDAQ, HKEX, Shanghai Stock Exchange, or Shenzhen Stock Exchange, or through M&A or other means. There are also over 110 portfolio companies that have achieved unicorn or super unicorn status.

Many of our portfolio companies are today's most influential firms in their respective sectors, including Xiaomi, Meituan, Bilibili, Zhihu, Roborock, Hesai Technology, UBTech, WeRide, HyperStrong, Insta360, Unisound, Biren Technology, Z.AI, Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals, Tigermed, Zai Lab, CanSino Biologics, Schrödinger, APT Medical, Sanyou Medical, AmoyDx, SinocellTech, Insilico Medicine, AusperBio, Yuanxin Technology, Medilink Therapeutics, LaNova Medicines, StepFun, among many others.

data.title: Tesla Opens Sales Of Autonomous Cybercab For 'Select' Customers — WSJ
data.description:
By Sean O'Kane

Tesla has begun taking orders for personally owned versions of its Cybercab, which has no steering wheel or pedals.

The company said in posts on X on Friday that "select customers are now being invited to purchase Cybercab for personal use" at an estimated purchase price of $29,990. The vehicle requires a $299-per-month subscription to Tesla's autonomy software and a $1,000 nonrefundable deposit.

The autonomous, two-door vehicle was previously only deployed in Tesla's taxi fleet.

The vehicles are estimated to be delivered in December, according to Tesla's posts.

The announcement comes after Tesla and its Chief Executive Elon Musk spent years promising the company would sell fully autonomous vehicles to regular customers. In 2016, Tesla claimed that all vehicles it was making at the time had the hardware necessary to become fully self-driving. In 2019, Musk predicted Tesla would have "over a million robotaxis" on the roads by the following year.

Those promises have yet to materialize, but Tesla has recently made progress toward its autonomous goals. The company has operated "Robotaxi" versions of its Model Y SUV in Austin, Texas since June 2025. That self-driving ride-hailing service has since expanded to other cities in Texas and Florida.

In September, Tesla started adding Cybercabs to the Austin fleet. The gold, two-seater vehicle has no manual driving controls that are required by federal motor vehicle safety standards.

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an investigation into whether the Cybercab complies with these regulations. Tesla has told the safety regulator that it believes the Cybercab meets the standards, but the company hasn't publicly explained its position.

Tesla and NHTSA didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.

The late Friday announcement also signals a possible shift for Tesla's autonomous strategy. On a call with investors in October, Musk said "the vast majority of the Cybercab stuff will be essentially Tesla-owned."

In the social-media posts Friday, the company explained in fine print that the personally owned Cybercabs will only be available to operate "in supported service areas." Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla's head of AI, said in a post that the vehicles will "work unsupervised inside all the same geo locations as" the company's existing Robotaxi service.

Tesla's claim that the Cybercab can only be purchased for personal use means buyers won't be able to immediately make money with the vehicle. The company had previously solicited interest in September for "Cybercab fleet vehicle purchasing." Musk has pitched shareholders on the idea that small fleet owners could manage Cybercabs "like a shepherd tends their flock."

Musk has also promised that customers would be able to add their own Teslas to a larger, autonomous ride-hailing network. On Tesla's October call with investors, Elluswamy said this functionality would come in the second quarter of 2027.

Write to Sean O'Kane at sean.okane@wsj.com

data.title: RBI said to allow e-rupee wallets within banking apps to boost adoption
data.description:
Mumbai, Nov. 14 -- The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has allowed banks to integrate digital rupee wallets into their main mobile banking apps, a move aimed at making the central bank's digital currency easier to access and encouraging wider use, according to two people aware of the development.

Until now, banks have offered separate apps for digital rupee wallets. Integrating them into existing banking apps would remove the need for customers to download another application to transact in the central bank digital currency (CBDC), potentially encouraging greater adoption.

"We are planning to integrate this within our app," said one of the bankers cited above. "The main app has a lot of visibility and therefore it would automatically translate into more usage of CBDC."

A CBDC, known in India as the digital rupee (e Rs.), is a digital form of legal tender issued directly by the RBI. It carries the same value as physical currency. Currently, 19 banks offer digital currency wallets. These include Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, State Bank of India, Union Bank and Bank of Baroda, according to RBI data.

"This is definitely beneficial for banks as they do not have to maintain two separate apps. For consumers, it will only make sense if there is more value than using UPI," said Mihir Gandhi, partner and leader, fintech and payments transformation, PwC India.

The RBI launched its retail CBDC pilot in December 2022, initially restricting it to a closed group of participating customers and merchants. In August, RBI deputy governor Rohit Jain told reporters that, since the currency was being used for actual transactions, it could no longer be described as a pilot.

Despite the central bank's expectations for CBDC, transaction volumes remain muted. Retail CBDC in circulation stood at Rs.771.66 crore in FY26, down from Rs.1,016.5 crore in the previous financial year, according to RBI data. In contrast, the value of total banknotes issued-including CBDC-increased from Rs.36.9 trillion to Rs.41.2 trillion over the same period.

An email sent to the RBI seeking comment remained unanswered.

Bankers said the wallets had initially been kept separate because the CBDC was still being tested, and the central bank had not been keen on allowing banks to integrate them into their main apps. With some traction now emerging, the RBI has approved the integration, they said.

"UPI has independent apps (third party) and it is also included in the banking apps. CBDC will also be like this," said the second banker cited above. "It's a very simple utility. You fund the CBDC wallet account from the savings bank account."

The move follows the RBI's decision in 2023 to allow customers to use CBDC wallets to make payments through UPI QR codes. Mint reported in September that while this interoperability gives CBDC access to a large existing merchant-facing infrastructure, the backend processing of such payments by banks and the RBI remains different and requires further work before it can be rolled out at scale.

Experts cautioned that integrating CBDC wallets into banking apps would not necessarily translate into a significant increase in users.

Gandhi of PwC said that although UPI is available on bank apps, most consumers prefer third-party payment applications. "There are so many features packed into a single bank app that customers find it hard to discover, while third-party apps are more focussed," he said.

The RBI has also allowed third-party apps to offer CBDC wallets, but only a handful have adopted the facility so far. Two non-bank platforms, CRED and MobiKwik, launched e-rupee wallets in 2025.

Parijat Garg, an independent fintech expert, said universal QR code acceptance was among the most significant developments for CBDC so far, as it allows customers to use existing UPI QR codes to make payments through their digital rupee wallets.

"Furthermore, if it is now available within the main bank app, of course discovery becomes easy for the consumer and the consumer is most likely to try," Garg said.

He said consumers had adopted UPI Lite partly because it was integrated into the wider UPI ecosystem and enjoyed better acceptance. "Consumers would now have another option to pay when eRupee wallets get integrated," he said.

UPI Lite is a wallet within UPI apps that allows customers to make transactions of up to Rs.1,000 without entering their PIN.
